critical_code_review_comments: routes/meals.py: bad office-side meal_breakfast_cutoff silently falls back to DEFAULT (07:00) — clean UX but hides misconfiguration. Consider adding a startup-time or PUT-time warn-log so admins see it.

PATCH /api/sites/{id} requires the full Pydantic payload (name+lat+lng mandatory) — that is why UI Sites.jsx sends the full body. If any future consumer PATCHes with partial fields (name only, radius only), it will 422. Consider switching PATCH to accept a partial-update model to match its verb semantics.

Office.jsx save() coerces number fields with Number() then rounds via Number(...) || 0 — a blank latitude becomes 0 rather than surfacing a validation error. Cutoff also uses `|| '07:00'` which quietly rewrites an empty picker to 07:00; safer would be to keep the previous value or prompt the user.

ChefsView.jsx: rendering the empty state uses `data?.cutoff` and `data?.today` after loading, which is fine, but the h1 tooltip depends on `data?.configured_cutoff` — if the first API call fails, the tooltip stays at 'Loading office setting…' with no visible retry.
